correctness.rationale: In area coordinates t=πr² the coherent-state density is a rank-one trace-class operator whose vector and derivatives in t have uniformly bounded Hilbert norms near s>0 (termwise differentiation of the factorially decaying monomial coordinates). Moving the upper limit gives trace-norm C⁴ and exact area preservation. The disc eigenvalues are strictly decreasing with gap b_N(s)>0 across the top block. Differentiating each simple eigenvalue twice gives A''_jj+2 Σ_{k≠j}|A'_jk|²/(λ_j−λ_k); the terms wholly in the block cancel in pairs. The diagonal first derivative vanishes and Σ_{j<N}b'_j=−b_{N−1}. The 1/2 from Taylor expansion cancels the factor 2 from real Parseval and the factor 2 in the off-block term, giving exactly L_{N,m}; the series is dominated since each summand is bounded by b_j. At m=1 only j=N−1 enters and the coefficient vanishes. At m=2, b_{j+2}/(b_{j+1}+b_{j+2})=s/(s+j+2), so the curvature reduces to b_{N−1}[1−(N−1)/(s+N)−s/(s+N+1)], including N=1 by omitting the zero term. Cos(2θ) gives Fourier weight 1/4 and rotation by π/2 makes the deficit even, proving the O(ε⁴) remainder. Fixed N,s,h and local only. RESULT.md §§1–5 provide the analytical replay; the two frozen scripts were inspected, not run, and their finite tests are not the proof.
